headlines.snippet: Sgt. Ron Yonatan Reitman, 23, from Ashkelon, and Cpl. Yuval Shai Suilam, 20, from Hod HaSharon, were killed in a shooting attack at the Judean checkpoint. Both served in the Combat Extraction Battalion. Three other soldiers sustained moderate and light injuries. The military believes the attackers planned a larger attack on civilians, which was thwarted by the soldiers' actions. The two attackers were neutralized, and an investigation is underway regarding a foreign photographer who may have had prior knowledge of the attack. The Prime Minister ordered an immediate lockdown of Hebron and preparations for a full closure of the West Bank.

headlines.snippet: The Israeli military estimates that the attackers, who killed two soldiers and injured three others near Hebron, were en route to carrying out a larger attack against civilians. headlines.snippet: Sgt. Ron Yonatan Reitman and Cpl. Yuval Shai Suilam were killed in a shooting attack near Hebron, which the military believes prevented a major attack on civilians. The two attackers opened fire on soldiers establishing a roadblock, resulting in the deaths of the two soldiers and injuries to three others. Commander of the Central Command, Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth, stated that the soldiers "prevented with their bodies a severe attack against civilians." The Prime Minister ordered an immediate lockdown of Hebron.
